# Configuration and Operations

Configure sites, deploy to production and upgrade between versions.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Configuration](configuration.md) | Configure a site with site_config.json and common_site_config.json, read values with frappe.conf, change them with bench set-config, and override them with environment variables. |
| [Deployment](deployment.md) | Run Frappe in production with the bench CLI - processes, Procfile, supervisor or systemd, nginx, workers and queues, socketio, maintenance mode and DNS multitenancy. |
